insight.headline: Function settings extensions can now report several errors at once
insight.what_changed: Function settings extensions can now report several errors at once. When your s-function-settings onSubmit handler rejects with an AggregateError, the Shopify admin shows every error on discount and checkout rule pages instead of only one. No action is required.
